title: Data fetching: server vs client, waterfalls, RSC, and SWR cache
summary: Where data fetching happens decides LCP. Server (RSC + streaming), client (TanStack Query / SWR), and the waterfall traps that destroy frontend latency.
crux: Server fetch + stream = LCP under 1s. Client fetch after JS = LCP over 3s. Waterfalls kill; Promise.all cures.
keytakeaway: Server fetch + stream beats client fetch for first paint. TanStack Query / SWR handle the post-mount cache. Waterfalls are silent killers — Promise.all everywhere.
